text:
Hi everyone,

As you may noticed, Facebook introduced a new feature - "Use nickname" for posts/replies.

As we want the community members to be open with each other and keep this space safe and supportive, we will not use this feature in our group.

As for now, the option to disable this feature is not yet implemented in the group settings, so we added it to the group rules and will follow this by deleting posts that will use nicknames. Usage of nicknames will be allowed only for objectively sensitive cases where anonymity is genuinely necessary.

As usual, if you want to post anonymously, the DM inboxes of the moderators are open.
